search_repositories.description: Search GitHub repositories and extract the top results.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to extract.

get_repo_info.description: Open a repository page and extract name, description, stars, and forks.

returns.description: Object with name, url, description, stars, forks.

get_trending_repos.description: Extract repositories from the GitHub trending page.

since.description: Trending window: daily, weekly, or monthly. Defaults to daily.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of repositories to extract.

returns.description: Array of {name, url, description, language, stars} objects.

extract_readme.description: Extract headings and text from the README rendered on the current repository page.

maxChars.description: Maximum number of README text characters to return.

returns.description: Object with headings array and truncated README text.
